mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at City Hall and the moon is in its third quarter phase. If you are a night owl, the space station will be visible at 3:35 AM, rising near Verona High School and moving toward Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky. Tonight's low will be 72 degrees with rain expected overnight.

The City of Verona is working on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round access for all. Additionally, we are thrilled to welcome the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture to Century School Park, a gift representing community art and wellness.

There is plenty to do in our area. Live music is taking place at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. On Friday, the Dane County Farmer's Market returns to the Capitol Square, and we have local trivia and markets coming up throughout early next week.
In a report from August 30, officers responded to a bicycle crash on East Verona Avenue. A 77-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield to a 15-year-old cyclist, who thankfully avoided injury.

Today's flavor was Snickers Swirl, but the store is now closed for the evening. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow morning at 10 AM when we will feature Chocolate Volcano as our flavor of the day.
